about_the_game:
Now... which girl shall I feed on next?

+18 lesbian yuri game, fully available in Spanish and English.

Demon: Erika, darling!

Erika: What do you want now?

Demon: How cold! Why are you always so mean to me?

Erika: Why, you ask? Do I need to remind you that you are a demon who has been with me since I was born and feeds on the lust of its victims? Because of you, I had so many problems at my previous university that everyone started seeing me as a monster. Even my parents kicked me out of the house. I had no choice but to move to another city and start a new life, away from all the chaos you caused.

Demon: Well, the past is the past! Now we live in a new city, with new people and new lust to savor, heh heh.

Erika: Is that all you can think about...?

Demon: What can I do? I'm hungry! Just like humans, I need to eat!

Erika: Well, sorry, but we've moved to an all-girls university, so you won't be eating for a while.

Demon: Oh, ho ho ho, don't worry, darling, that won't stop me. It just so happens I love girls. And I won't stop until I've tasted every last drop of lust from each girl you meet.

Erika: Oh, god...

Demon: And it seems that, for now, we've met a few girls worth our time, heh heh. Why don't you remind me who they are?

Erika: Do you have such a bad memory?

Erika: The first is Megumi, a sweet and enthusiastic girl who quickly became my friend. Thanks to her, we got to know the city better and I found a job. She's really adorable.

Demon: Adorable and delicious, heh heh, I can't wait to savor her completely.

Erika: The next is Nicole, as cheerful as Megumi, but a little more relaxed. She seems to be a huge food fan. How the hell can she eat so much without gaining weight?

Demon: I don't know, but she's definitely my favorite. You should take her to our bed by any means necessary. If she eats a lot, I eat even more. And I want to devour all her energy, heh heh.

Erika: Then we have Nanami, the most mature and responsible of the group. She's very pretty, but, unfortunately for you, she's straight and has a boyfriend, so there's nothing we can do with her.

Demon: We'll see, darling. A demon's powers should not be taken lightly, heh heh, I'll make sure that girl falls at our feet.

Erika: Finally, we have the maid cafe girls. From left to right, not counting me, I'm the first: Momo-chan, Runa-chan, Hana-chan, and Hinata-san.

Demon: What kind of names are those?

Erika: Don't look at me... They work at a maid cafe, so they have to look as cute as possible to please the customers. And I will also start working there, so I guess I'll have to dress as a maid and start doing... cute things... ugh...

Demon: I can't wait to see you act like that, ha ha ha! And I also can't wait to get to know those girls better, especially Momo-chan. I wonder if she'll be just as cute without that cosplay and makeup.

Demon: Are those all the girls we know?

Erika: For now, yes. Although...

Demon: Although...?

Erika: There's one more girl, the one who always gives me a mean look in class. I don't know why.

Demon: Ah, yes, her. I can sense something strange about her. She's definitely different from the others. Be very careful with her.

Erika: Alright...

In this visual novel, you'll make decisions that will impact Erika's life and the lives of those around her forever. Throughout 12 chapters, you'll have the opportunity to build relationships (whether friendship or romance) with a variety of characters who will appear throughout the story. The demon inside you needs to feed on lust to survive and grow stronger. Will you turn her into the most powerful demon by feeding her many girls, or will you control your sexual urges to weaken her instead? Be careful with your decisions. They will guide the plot one way or another, leading you to one of the many endings planned for this game. And not all of them will be good. You wouldn't want to end up with a bad one, right? Or would you?

The game is currently under development, with 6 out of 12 chapters completed. Updates are made every one or two months because, as development progresses, more decisions and paths arise, which increases development time.

Have a great day!

content_descriptors.notes: The sexual content involves engaging in sexual relationships with the girls and suggestive scenes. In future updates, the possibility of murdering characters will be added, but this will never be graphically described. Additionally, all sexual content and deaths depend on the player's decisions. The game can be completed without viewing any deaths or sexual scenes.
